dedupeText: retro rock compilation cover eagle silhouette nebula background serif typography 80s rock aesthetic purple and teal gradient the purple eagle silhouette acts as the central focal point against the dark cosmic void the gold tan serif title at the top balances the gold tan list of names at the bottom teal and blue light flares provide diagonal movement behind the static central icon combine a central animal silhouette with a cosmic nebula background and frame it with classic high contrast serif typography for a retro rock aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast album cover featuring a central purple eagle silhouette carrying a branch, set against a dark, textured cosmic background with teal and blue light flares. The layout uses a top-heavy title and a bottom-weighted list of names, framed by a dark border.
coreVisualRelationships: The purple eagle silhouette acts as the central focal point against the dark cosmic void.
The gold/tan serif title at the top balances the gold/tan list of names at the bottom.
Teal and blue light flares provide diagonal movement behind the static central icon.
coreInvariants: Dark purple/black background with textured light leaks
Solid color silhouette of a bird of prey in flight

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large eagle silhouette occupies the center-middle, scaled to approximately 50% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold serif title at the top edge serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top title, moves down through the eagle silhouette, and rests on the detailed list of names at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space around the central icon allows the light flares to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and black for the background and central silhouette.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and cyan for the atmospheric light flares.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold/tan for the primary text and red for the secondary subtitle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text and the dark, moody background.

letterConstructionRules: Mixed case for titles, all-caps for subtitles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight tracking on the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, large-scale serif for the title paired with a condensed, all-caps serif for the credits list.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines flanking the word 'Featuring'

preserve: Gold and red color coding for text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, authoritative serif feel of the era.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs for the title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark purple and black cosmic background with soft, diagonal teal and blue light flares. In the center, place a solid purple silhouette of an eagle in flight, holding a small branch in its talons.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large gold serif title at the top. Below it, add a red all-caps subtitle. At the bottom, add a list of names in a condensed gold serif font, centered, with horizontal lines flanking the word 'Featuring'.

verificationChecks: Is the eagle silhouette a solid, flat purple?
Is the background dark with visible teal light leaks?
Is the layout vertically balanced between top and bottom text?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the teal light flares
Specific pose of the eagle silhouette
Shade of gold for the typography
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the teal flares do not obscure the text legibility.
Check that the eagle silhouette is clearly recognizable.
Verify the red subtitle is distinct from the gold title.
Confirm the bottom text is centered and organized.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central animal silhouette with a cosmic/nebula background and frame it with classic, high-contrast serif typography for a retro-rock aesthetic.
